fields.Name: T085 - Entity Form FK Field Typeahead Search and Select
fields.Description: Exercises the mj-fk-search typeahead autocomplete in EDIT mode (async related-record search + suggestion dropdown) — a completely different code path from read-mode FK link navigation (T214) and FK display-name rendering (T92), and from the static <select> dropdown editor (T207).

InputDefinition.goal: Open the 'Event Registrations' entity via the LEFT sidebar 'Search entities...' box (type 'Event Registrations', click the exact match), click any row, then click 'Open Full Record'. Click the Edit (pencil) button to enter edit mode. Find a foreign-key field (e.g. 'Member' or 'Event') — it renders as a text box with a magnifying-glass icon. Click it and type a few characters; a dropdown of matching related records should appear. The success condition is that the FK autocomplete dropdown renders search results (a results grid/list) OR shows a clear 'No matches' state as you type — you do NOT need to actually save. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: In edit mode, a foreign-key field renders as a searchable text input with a magnifying-glass icon (not a plain dropdown)
Typing into the FK field triggers a dropdown that shows matching related-record suggestions OR a clear 'No matches' empty state
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
